column1: # The union families of the registry whose instances rest on per-leg hand assertions
# rather than a shared expectation: each leg's own Go test writes the expected answer
# itself, so a leg asserting the wrong answer passes. The corpus-migration card moves
# each into one shared case every driver answers (Glenn, 2026-11-24).
# Found by a scan (survey tool hand, L5). A leg's test is hand-asserted, marked *, when its
# body and the package functions it calls (two deep) name no shared source of the answer
# (a corpus or testdata file, the reference engine, an oracle, a golden, the conformance
# harness), or when they write an expected answer by hand: a want-named value or table
# field holding a literal, a comparison with a literal, or an assertion with a literal in
# an embedded probe. A test that reads a corpus and also writes answers by hand is marked.
# basis: hand = every case's legs are hand-asserted; mixed = some are.
